title: God Reaffirms His Promise

questions.question: What did God promise to do for Israel?
options: Deliver them from Egypt with an outstretched arm
questions.correctAnswer: Deliver them from Egypt with an outstretched arm
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:6 (ESV): "I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians... I will redeem you with an outstretched arm."

questions.question: Who did God send with Moses to speak to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:13 (ESV): "The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge to the people of Israel and to Pharaoh."

questions.question: What relationship did God want to establish with Israel?
options: I will be your God, you will be my people
questions.correctAnswer: I will be your God, you will be my people
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:7 (ESV): "I will take you to be my people, and I will be your God."

questions.question: What land did God promise to give Israel?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:8 (ESV): "I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."

questions.question: How old was Moses when he confronted Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:7 (ESV): "Now Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh."

questions.question: By what name did God say He was known to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:3 (ESV): "I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty, but by my name the Lord I did not make myself known to them."

questions.question: Why did the Israelites not listen to Moses initially?
options: Their broken spirit and harsh slavery
questions.correctAnswer: Their broken spirit and harsh slavery
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:9 (ESV): "They did not listen to Moses, because of their broken spirit and harsh slavery."

questions.question: What four "I wills" did God declare in Exodus 6:6-7?
options: Bring out, deliver, redeem, take as my people
questions.correctAnswer: Bring out, deliver, redeem, take as my people
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:6-7 (ESV): "I will bring you out... I will deliver you... I will redeem you... I will take you to be my people."

questions.question: What did Moses say was his problem when speaking to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:12 (ESV): "How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, for I am of uncircumcised lips?"

questions.question: What did God remember that led Him to act for Israel?
options: His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
questions.correctAnswer: His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob

questions.question: From which tribe were Moses and Aaron?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:16-20 (ESV): The genealogy shows they were descendants of Levi through Kohath and Amram.

questions.question: Who were the parents of Moses and Aaron?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:20 (ESV): "Amram took as his wife Jochebed his father's sister, and she bore him Aaron and Moses."

questions.question: Who was Aaron's wife according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:23 (ESV): "Aaron took as his wife Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab."

questions.question: What were the names of Aaron's four sons?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:23 (ESV): "She bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar."

questions.question: How many years did Levi live according to Exodus 6:16?
questions.explanation: Exodus 6:16 (ESV): "The years of the life of Levi were 137 years."

key_verse_text: I will take you to be my people, and I will be your God, and you shall know that I am the Lord your God, who has brought you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
